results: Norm-decreasing inclusions between arbitrary source spectral weights preserve every raw Fourier coefficient,the full original H-minus-one potential,and the full original H1 reduced resolvent. The original physical unit-weight effective diagonal and both couplings are proved equal to the weighted corrected-mode coefficients. The full-strip general-weight diagonal/coupling error estimates and coupling size bounds therefore concern the SAME original singular operator,not a replacement weighted characteristic.

The actual full-strip coupling radius retains the entire arbitrary spectral weight. Every actual complex physical high pair satisfies the DOUBLE-frequency bound W(2n)*abs(gap)<=2*sqrt(6)*norm(q),and the mode-number bound W(n)*abs(gap)<=6*sqrt(6)*norm(q),where W(k)=w(k)*(1+abs(k))^(-r). No cutoff or constant depends on w.

Forgetting only the extra weight decreases the exact original norm with constant1 and preserves EVERY smooth-test action,so mean-zero,reality and physical period-one constraints remain unchanged on restriction. Source Lemma2.9 weighted diagonal/coupling errors hold for the literal original physical entries and source Fourier coefficients on the whole corrected strip. Those entries are jointly complex analytic in the EXACT original weighted norm and spectral parameter.

The actual sourceWeightedCanonicalGaps is the COMPLETE canonical lexicographic gap sequence,including its central prefix,for the SAME original weighted source distribution. It belongs to the genuine general-weight endpoint infinity space. Positive-index values are explicitly lambda_(2n)-lambda_(2n-1);the signed extension is even and zero at0.

One cutoff is chosen BEFORE BOTH the source spectral weight and original potential on every exact original weighted norm ball. The explicit full bound is abs(w(N)*(8*sourceSpectralBound(r,R)+4*pi^2*N^2)+6*sqrt(6)*R),with N independent of w. The statement retains N in this bound. Literal local boundedness is proved in the original weighted norm topology.

The proof applies to the full period-two complex weighted distribution space,so in particular to the original complex mean-zero physically period-one source.
